objective: Seed-label the 1,959-crop unlabeled glyph exemplar bank (experiments/char_inventory/out) with one open-vocabulary reading per crop, converting geometry-only inventory into a training and verification asset. This is the Vesuvius Challenge bootstrap move adopted by vesuvius_research: weak seed labels first, hardening loop after.
hypothesis: A majority of crops resolve to a single character with usable certainty stratification; the labeled bank plus MTHv2's 100k labeled boxes and the 1,131 blind adjudication verdicts form the training set for a local glyph classifier (the fourth evidence channel and the cheap first stage of adjudication).

instrument.model: gemini-3.5-flash, temperature 0, minimal thinking, schema-bound {character, certainty, notes}
instrument.rules: exactly one codepoint, variant forms kept (no normalization), empty character when illegible; resumable; budget-capped
instrument.smoke: first 5 crops labeled live: 慮/脈/光 high-certainty plus two explicit illegibles, ~0.0024 USD per crop

label_status: SEED labels, development-only. Not gold, never qualification evidence. Hardening path: model-vs-model disagreement review, then expert verification through the draft queue per the gold protocol.

gates.coverage: every crop in the index receives a row (labeled or explicit illegible/failed)
gates.resolution: at least 70 percent of crops labeled with a non-empty character
gates.audit: top character families spot-checked against the inventory contact sheet for gross misreads
gates.budget_stop: label --max-cost stops before the next call

non_goals: No classifier training in this record (separate preflight once labels exist).
next_permitted_action: Run the full labeling pass under the declared budget, then summarize, audit, and record.
